purpose: Coherent multi-file product objectives for unattended Bikeztagram engineering.

features.title: Cinematic edit quality
features.objective: Improve the real editing pipeline so director decisions produce a coherent hook/build/reveal/action/hero sequence, varied purposeful motion and transitions, and reliable timing in the final render.
acceptance: planner output is consumed by the renderer

features.title: Editor reliability
features.objective: Make interrupted analysis, reload and missing-media situations recoverable in the real editor without losing usable project metadata.

features.title: Social export reliability
features.objective: Make final social exports reliable across 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 profiles with truthful duration, progress and failure handling.
acceptance: duration metadata agrees with rendered output

features.title: Android editor experience
features.objective: Improve touch-first editing on Android while preserving the cinematic visual identity and existing workflow.
